newsitem.title: USA: US Midco spot prods up in quiet pre-Christmas talk.
newsitem.headline: US Midco spot prods up in quiet pre-Christmas talk.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot refined product prices rose Tuesday in line with futures on NYMEX, but talk in cash markets was too subdued ahead of Wednesday' Christmas Day Holiday, traders said.
"It's really dead out there," said one trader, noting diffs were likely unchanged.
Unleaded prices were up by nearly 0.70 cent a gallon, while heating oil and jet fuel advanced just 0.32 cent.
Prompt unleaded in the Group was talked 3.50 cents under January futures. Chicago prompt prices were assessed between 5.00 and 4.75 cents under the screen.
Previously, traders said spot markets were well supplied, and that few players were scrambling for supply.
Basis in Chicago markets were generally firming less markedly than in the Group, traders said.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
